description: NaTmO₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four TmO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven TmO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.65 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four TmO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven TmO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.63 Å. There are two inequivalent Tm³⁺ sites. In the first Tm³⁺ site, Tm³⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form TmO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TmO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five TmO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-13°. There are four shorter (2.24 Å) and two longer (2.25 Å) Tm-O bond lengths. In the second Tm³⁺ site, Tm³⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form TmO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TmO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five TmO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-13°. There are a spread of Tm-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.26 Å. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and three Tm³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tm₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-12°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and three Tm³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tm₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-12°.
